Client: Demo Realty Private Limited
Project: Sales Process Digitization

Zoho CRM
- Capture website and Meta lead enquiries.
- Assign leads to sales executives using rules approved by the sales manager.
- Track follow-up calls and site visit appointments.
- Send WhatsApp site visit reminders; the provider must be confirmed.
- Track deals with discount approval before closure.
- There are 20 CRM users.

Zoho Analytics
- Build a lead-source dashboard and sales pipeline dashboard from CRM data.
- KPI formulas and refresh frequency need client confirmation.

Data Migration / Cleansing
- Clean and migrate 8,000 lead records from Excel.
- Deduplication and field mapping rules need client approval.

Training
- Train CRM sales executives and an administrator.

Cost Proposal
- Zoho CRM
- Zoho Analytics
- Data Migration / Cleansing
- Training

No approved prices, support period or final project schedule are supplied.
